name: pre_snapshot_timed_cursor
comment: 56-F2 (swmr variant): a read with a SUPPLIED positioned cursor (epoch=0, seq=5, arbitrary -- no snapshot has ever been established, so no sequence position can be valid) and timeout_ms=50 still holds (there is nothing to resolve against, regardless of the claimed seq) and emits SetTimer{1,50}; timer_expired{1} answers would_block with next_cursor ABSENT -- via the canonical resolver (PH0-D19), never echoing the originally supplied seq=5
